news.title: Compliance and access dominate university assessment plans, confirms testing giant
news.summary_en: Growing scrutiny of international student recruitment is prompting universities to place greater emphasis on trusted and accessible English language assessments.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: Explained: How India’s biggest medical entrance exam descended into crisis
news.summary_en: An alleged paper leak, an unprecedented nationwide retest and mounting political pressure have thrust NEET, India's medical entrance examination, into the spotlight, laying bare the intense pressure and high stakes behind one of the world's largest medical admissions systems.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: International students intimidated by St George’s flag as hostile rhetoric surges
news.summary_en: There has been a noticeable shift in the way international students view the English flag as they grapple with a wave of anti-immigration messaging in the UK, a conference has heard.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Indian students weigh outcomes more as rupee weakness adds costs
news.summary_en: Currency volatility is adding pressure to Indian students already grappling with rising tuition fees, living costs and tighter immigration policies, prompting many to reassess budgets, borrowing plans and destination choices.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK Lords warn of “woefully inadequate” migration data amid settlement reform review
news.summary_en: The UK government is making major decisions on settlement and citizenship without adequate migration data, a House of Lords committee has warned, as it called for ministers to reconsider plans to extend the qualifying period for permanent residence for migrants.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Int’l students face cost, confusion and access barriers in English testing
news.summary_en: UKCISA research involving around 750 students found cost and access barriers, confusion over accepted English language qualifications, and concerns that language tests do not fully prepare students for life and study in the UK.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK leaders warn unis to rethink skills, partnerships and AI
news.summary_en: UK higher education leaders have urged universities to embrace new ways of working as many find themselves at the sharp end of financial woes and falling international student numbers.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: AIECA launch marks new chapter for education agents
news.summary_en: A “new era” for Australia’s education agent sector has been marked with the launch of the Australian International Education Counsellors Association (AIECA), formed through the merger of ISEAA and ECAA.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Scotland and Wales to pilot phone outreach for international graduates
news.summary_en: A new graduate outcomes pilot will contact international alumni by telephone from December 2026 as the sector seeks stronger evidence of graduate outcomes beyond the UK.
news.author: Kim Martin
